detail: term sheet declares barrier_level_pct absent; booking has 70

triage.desk_query: Term sheet G10 contains no knock-in barrier provision — no clause stating a barrier level as a percentage of initial level appears anywhere in the document, so the extraction is recorded as ABSENT. The booking record nonetheless carries barrier_level_pct = 70. Confirm whether this note is in fact barrier-protected at 70% and the term sheet we hold is an incomplete or superseded version (please supply the final/amended term sheet or the relevant knock-in clause), or whether the note has no barrier and the booking must be corrected to remove the 70 value.
triage.rationale: A 70% knock-in is a core economic term that would not be omitted from a correct final term sheet, so the more likely defect is that the document on file is incomplete or superseded rather than the booking being fabricated.
